purpose: Pre-2024 hypothesis-generation decomposition of repeated decision behavior in one public BitMEX account ledger; never a copied strategy or rank-eligible result.

source.pin_method: fetch and checkout the exact pinned commit before manifest and economic reconstruction
source.effective_timestamp: timestamp first; transactTime only when timestamp is unavailable
source.future_rows: transport-only; discard before behavior reconstruction and prohibit from summaries, hypotheses and decisions

scope.symbols: inverse XBT derivatives only; XBTUSD plus dated XBT futures; XBT_USDT spot is excluded
scope.position_episode: flat-to-position through flat or sign reversal; no arbitrary time split
scope.partial_fills: multiple fills sharing one order ID are collapsed to one behavior action after position accounting

fixed_decomposition: scale-in while favorable versus adverse to the current inverse-cost reference
direct sign reversal and re-entry within 60 minutes
initial and maximum size after prior winning versus losing episode

pnl_semantics.inverse_contract_trade_pnl: for a long reduction q*(1/average_entry_price - 1/exit_price); short is the sign-reversed expression; average entry is harmonic in contract quantity
pnl_semantics.execution_commission: subtract source-native execComm after converting XBt satoshi units to XBT
pnl_semantics.funding: assign funding rows only while the same symbol episode is open, using wallet-history address as the source-native symbol field
pnl_semantics.episode_net_proxy: inverse realised trade PnL minus execution commission plus matched-symbol funding
pnl_semantics.wallet_history: symbol-level and total cross-check layer only; no forced equality because wallet history includes other instruments, transfers, conversion and accounting adjustments
pnl_semantics.authority_boundary: episode outcome is a behavioral proxy, not reconstructed account NAV

hypothesis_rule.authorization: idea evidence only; any Bybit test must be separately preregistered and frozen through 2023-12-31

no_strategy_when: evidence is dominated by rare long-duration episodes
positive PnL is concentrated in a small tail without a repeated causal behavior
no behavior has sufficient breadth and a coherent economic payer
the required Bybit queue and trade-through evidence is not registered
decision_rule.possible_next_step: open at most one separate canonical-Bybit preregistration when a repeated behavior survives the fixed descriptive screen and its required source is available

prohibited: copying external thresholds, sizes, sides or holding times
using external-account rows after 2023-12-31 for rule formation
calling this a backtest or ranking result
credentials, paper orders, testnet orders or live orders
